acceptance_criteria.criterion: All tests pass via npm test.
Tests verify that existing settings in a .code-workspace file are not overwritten by generateWorkspaceFile().
Tests verify the JSON structure of newly created workspace files.
Tests use temporary directories for isolation.

summary: All 274 tests pass (0 failures). WP-003 adds 13 tests for vscode-workspace.ts covering getWorkspaceFilePath, generateWorkspaceFile (new and existing files), and removeWorkspaceFile. All four acceptance criteria verified: (1) npm test passes, (2) settings preservation on update confirmed by dedicated test, (3) JSON structure of new files verified with folder/settings assertions, (4) all tests use makeTempDir() with fs.mkdtempSync for isolation.

comments.note: Edge case: corrupt JSON in existing .code-workspace silently recreates file — acceptable behavior documented in code.
Edge case: empty repoPaths array handled correctly — produces valid JSON with folders:[] and settings:{}.

summary: WP-003 code review PASS. Source (vscode-workspace.ts) and test file (vscode-workspace.test.ts) reviewed in full. Architecture is clean: minimal three-function API, VsCodeWorkspaceFile interface with index signature correctly preserves arbitrary keys, JSDoc on all exports. One Fix-Forward applied (temp-dir cleanup registration in test file). Two documentation-forward items tagged for the Documentation agent. No blocking issues.

comments.note: Added module-level _tempDirs tracking array + process.on('exit') cleanup handler to src/tests/vscode-workspace.test.ts. Each makeTempDir() call now registers the created directory for deletion on process exit, matching the cleanup pattern used in branch-orchestrator.test.ts. Non-behavioral: test assertions are unchanged.

[documentation-forward] generateWorkspaceFile() in src/orchestration/vscode-workspace.ts accepts repoPaths: { slug: string; path: string }[] but the slug field is never read inside the function — only path is used. Add a comment to the JSDoc param block clarifying whether slug is reserved for future use or is included for caller-side data-model consistency, to avoid confusion for future contributors.
fs.rmSync(filePath) in removeWorkspaceFile() is correct but fs.unlinkSync(filePath) is marginally more semantically precise for single-file deletion. Not worth changing — rmSync works correctly.
